label: fix:start-practice-runner
result:
I fixed all nine items, and the work is in one commit. Head commit: **df7cf860** on `web/fix-start-1017`, in the worktree `C:\Users\atish\Desktop\mockmob copy\wt-fx-start`.

**Checks run:**
- I captured 390x844 and 1440x900 in Night and Day through `/preview/arena`, using real pointer clicks that were hit-tested, and opened every capture.
- Lint is clean on the changed files.
- Test suites all pass: test:recovery 415/0, test:app 498/0, test:learning 347/0, test:nta 188/0, test:dock 5/0.
- `npx next build --webpack` passed.
- The dev server is stopped, and I deleted `.next` after the build.
- Captures are in `C:\Users\atish\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-atish-Desktop-mockmob-copy\604ced81-3aa7-4deb-b42c-f324ca5f51e2\scratchpad\fx\shots\` (folders `final`, `final2`, `r2`–`r6`). That folder is a temp scratchpad, so copy anything you need before it is cleared.

**Per item:**
- **W-002 – fixed.**
  - Each Practice tile now has a "Set up" key that reads "Chosen" with a tick once picked. A press visibly darkens the tile as it sinks, and the Start key settles in with its new label.
  - The Start sheet now has By chapter (opens Practice with the chapter list already open) and Smart practice rows. Every row and tile says what it does: "Set up", "Pick chapters" or "Open".
  - Evidence: `final/P-*-full.png`, `r4/P-390-light-press.png`, `final2/S-*-end.png`.
- **W-003 – fixed.**
  - Sheet subject logos went from 64 to 88 px (95 px when chosen; the top card's art is 112 px on phone, 132 px on desktop).
  - The top card's name changes live, e.g. "10 Economics questions".
  - The "Finish your recall session" card stays fixed, but now says "The sessions below are in Economics".
  - I also fixed a bug where the chosen subject chip stayed half off screen after picking it.
  - Evidence: `final2/S-*-econ.png`, `final/SF-*-econ.png`.
- **W-005 – fixed.**
  - A Fine-tune summary (chapters, difficulty, Edit) now sits right above Start: in the desktop session card, and as one line in the phone bar.
  - Chapter search now matches chapter names only (unit names are a fallback) and highlights what was typed. Typing "partn" now shows only chapters containing it.
  - Evidence: `r4/P-390-pick-partn.png`, `r4/P-1440-light-edit.png`, `r6/P-390-bar-q.png`.
- **W-008 – fixed.**
  - On phones the session bar now appears once you reach Questions, so it no longer covers the subjects or mode tiles on the first screen. It still never reappears further down the page, so the F12 fix holds.
  - The desktop bottom half is two balanced columns.
  - Evidence: `final/P-390-*-0.png`, `final/P-1440-*-bottom.png`.
  - This changes START-1017's "bar shows from the first frame" decision.
- **W-012 – fixed.**
  - Pressing Start on a Full mock or NTA turns the stopwatch hand 360° over 640 ms, on the key and on the Full mock tile, before the paper opens. I measured the hand at 220–273° then 342–353° mid-turn. With reduced motion the button just dims briefly.
  - The NTA loading screen now shows a drawn, running stopwatch instead of the glowing dot.
  - NTA tile contents stay inside their boxes, with no horizontal overflow at either width.
  - Evidence: `final/M-1440-t200.png`, `final2/M-390-t200.png`, `final/NB-*.png`.
- **W-013 – fixed.** Tiles, Fine-tune, the session card and the phone bar now have a soft cool-blue light from the top edge and a fine static grain, in Night and Day. I did not compare against the actual pre-15 Oct screenshots. Evidence: `final/P-1440-*-0.png`.
- **W-014 – fixed, following his newer words.** Desktop objects are 116 px (chosen) and 104 px, with eased motion. On phones they stay at 88 px rather than going back to 60 px, because his 17 Oct F7 ("increase the size of the logos") is newer than the 15 Oct "390 unchanged".
- **W-017 – fixed.** The notice now reads "Saved on this device. Stay online to submit. Bank in review." It is one line (31 px tall) at 390. Evidence: `final/RQ-*.png`.
- **W-018 – fixed.** The "not server-verified proctoring" line is deleted. No proctoring, privacy or screenshot wording appears in either theme or width. Evidence: `final/NT-*-entry.png`.
- **W-023 – fixed.**
  - Losing focus while the test still shows counts only after 3 s, and focus coming back sooner cancels it.
  - A hidden tab or leaving fullscreen counts at once. There are 3 warnings in total and no other grace.
  - New tests confirm a 2 s interruption adds no warning and a 4 s one adds one.
  - Limit: a desktop alt-tab that leaves the tab visible looks the same to the browser as a notification, so it counts after 3 s rather than at once.

**Verifier's extra notes:**
- **Two lime Start buttons on phones:** not changed. The dock's lime Start key is the accepted second under the A1 rule.
- **Sidebar Start key flipping on Practice load:** fixed; the loading state now keeps the key's look from the first frame.
- **Desktop session card sliding under the top bar near the page end:** left as normal scrolling.
- **Full mock cost wrapping over 4 lines in the sheet:** now "50 credits. You have 40.", two lines at most.
- **Sheet links in the preview not preselecting the mode:** a preview-only issue; I checked the By chapter link by opening its real address.

**Decision for you:** at 1440x900 the desktop Start button sits about 36 px below the first screen in the preview, because of the preview's own banner. On the real page it should fit, but I have not checked that.
